desc:
Open lucky boxes, collect letters, and crack all 10 codes! Explore the map, hunt for stars, and work toward the current free limited UGC reward.

⭐ Collect stars to open Lucky Boxes.
📦 Every box gives you a chance to find letters.
🔓 Complete all 10 codes to claim the featured free UGC while copies remain.
🚩 Capture the flag for extra stars.
💣 Challenge other players with bombs and keep the star hunt exciting.
😴 Prefer a slower pace? Visit the AFK farm and work toward your next code.

Check the “Today's UGC” podium for the current reward and remaining copies. Free reward stock is limited. Other UGC items in the shop may cost Robux.

Which box will reveal your next missing letter?
